visualCharacteristics.structure: 2-column grid (2x2) of report-column groups inside a white panel, 2px gap between columns, stacks to 1 column below 900px
visualCharacteristics.header: each group has a header bar with bold group name, a ~250px search input, and two small square icon buttons (clear /icons/clear.svg, move-up /icons/move-up.svg)
visualCharacteristics.body: body with bold "Select All / Unselect All" links and a checkbox list
visualCharacteristics.behavior: search filters the group options; clear empties the search; move-up moves checked options to the top; select all / unselect all toggle checkboxes; the preceding h2 bar toggles the picker open/closed (aria-expanded, ▼/▶); adds an "Enter Report Name" input before the following Save Report Template button

contentPattern.pattern: report column picker: group title | option list
contentPattern.structure: one row per column group: title (text) | options (richtext ul, one li per checkbox label)
